invariant: Sync uses iCloud Drive Ubiquity (NSFileCoordinator/NSMetadataQuery) and never CloudKit databases
why_it_matters: Docs and copy claiming CloudKit were a resolved hallucination; reintroducing CloudKit APIs breaks the audited sync model
failure_mode: Silent divergence between docs and code; broken multi-device sync assumptions

invariant: Recently copied workspace files get mtime touched to now so the 15-minute sweep guard protects them before metadata registration completes
why_it_matters: Prevents the deletion sweep from destroying freshly imported user documents
failure_mode: Imported documents deleted by background sweep = user data loss

invariant: Relational metadata lives in ONE shared SQLite file with container_id column isolation (not per-library files) and is strictly local
why_it_matters: Schema or isolation changes are destructive migrations affecting every existing user database
failure_mode: Cross-container data leakage or corrupted metadata on migration

invariant: FTS5 tokenizer behavior must match Swift-level unicode normalization exactly
why_it_matters: Mismatch silently drops keyword search hits
failure_mode: Keyword search returns incomplete results with no error

invariant: BNNSVectorDatabase is memory-mapped; on-disk vector format and dimensionality are frozen without an explicit re-index plan
why_it_matters: Format change invalidates every user's existing vector index
verification_command: full xcodebuild test plus manual retrieval regression on an existing index
failure_mode: Existing libraries return zero/garbage results after update

invariant: Provider fallback chain (Core AI on iOS 27+ -> Core ML -> NL) must remain intact; embedding dimension changes require full re-index
why_it_matters: Stored vectors are only searchable against same-dimension same-provider embeddings
verification_command: grep -rn 'CoreMLSentenceEmbeddingProvider' OpenIntelligence/Services/Embedding/ (fallback path present); build smoke
failure_mode: Older devices lose embedding capability or new vectors mismatch stored index

invariant: Tokenization uses Rust-backed swift-tokenizers with exact byte-level offsets (legacy BertTokenizer removed)
why_it_matters: Citation highlighting depends on exact byte offsets; regressing to approximate tokenizers breaks citation alignment
failure_mode: Citations highlight wrong text spans; user trust loss

invariant: PrivateCloudComputeLanguageModel is instantiated only behind the runtime EntitlementChecker gate
why_it_matters: Instantiation without the com.apple.developer.private-cloud-compute entitlement causes a FATAL process crash
failure_mode: App crashes at launch/first query on unentitled builds

invariant: The active .entitlements file intentionally OMITS the PCC entitlement until developer-account approval; runtime falls back to local SystemLanguageModel
why_it_matters: Re-adding the entitlement breaks Xcode Cloud archive export signing
failure_mode: Archive/export signing failures in CI; blocked releases

invariant: All cloud execution passes through FoundationModelRoutePolicy consent evaluation; background paths must not block on CloudConsentPromptView
why_it_matters: Known deadlock class when background tasks or intents await UI consent
verification_command: manual test: trigger query via App Intent with cloud routing enabled and no prior consent
failure_mode: Retrieval pipeline hangs indefinitely in background contexts

invariant: Billing entitlements are stored in UserDefaults via EntitlementStore (NOT Keychain; Keychain is for API keys only)
why_it_matters: Well-meaning 'security fix' to Keychain strands existing users' entitlement state
failure_mode: Paying users lose Pro/Lifetime entitlements after update

invariant: Evidence Thread creation is quota-gated by tier: 5 Free / 20 Pro / Unlimited Lifetime via QuotaPolicy
why_it_matters: Quota changes are revenue-affecting product decisions reserved to the user
failure_mode: Free users get unlimited paid features or paid users get blocked

invariant: StoreKitConfiguration.storekit product definitions must match App Store Connect and are agent-frozen
why_it_matters: Drift breaks purchase flows and quota resolution in production and sandbox
verification_command: git diff --stat -- '*.storekit' (expect empty in any agent change)
failure_mode: Broken purchases; App Review rejection

invariant: App Shortcut registrations must stay at or below 10 (currently 9 of 10 slots used)
why_it_matters: Exceeding the OS limit causes SILENT registration failure of all shortcuts
failure_mode: All Siri/Shortcuts integration silently disappears

invariant: ChatMessage model shape is frozen; messages persist as monolithic JSON arrays; EvidenceThread wraps ChatMessage arrays immutably
why_it_matters: Any Codable shape change silently breaks or loses existing chat histories and thread files
verification_command: round-trip decode of an existing persisted chat JSON fixture after any model edit
failure_mode: Users lose conversation history on update

invariant: Evidence Threads live under Application Support/EvidenceThreads/<containerId>/ (Design B) and sync bidirectionally via WorkspaceSyncService
why_it_matters: Moving the path or bypassing coordinated writes corrupts cross-device thread sync
failure_mode: Thread loss or sync conflicts across devices

invariant: Ingestion checkpoints are stored under localCacheDir()/IngestionCheckpoints/<fingerprint>/ and must remain excluded from iCloud sync paths
why_it_matters: Checkpoints are resumable-state internals; syncing them causes cross-device corruption and quota waste
failure_mode: Resumed ingestion uses stale foreign-device state

invariant: Large documents (>=10MB) ingest via streamed page batches with incremental FTS5 append (no whole-document memory load)
why_it_matters: OOM safety and searchability of large PDFs depend on this contract
verification_command: manual ingest of a >10MB PDF then keyword+vector query; DocumentProcessorTests
failure_mode: Large imports crash the app or produce unsearchable documents

invariant: No destructive git commands; no doc deletion; evidence_level+confidence tags on all architecture claims; agents stop for PROCEED: IMPLEMENT before source edits
why_it_matters: The entire audit trail and repo safety model depends on these process invariants
verification_command: git status --porcelain after each phase; review of agent transcript
failure_mode: Unrecoverable history loss or ungoverned changes

invariant: Every feature change updates README.md CHANGELOG.md Docs/ROADMAP.md Docs/OPENINTELLIGENCE_ARCHITECTURE_ATLAS.md Docs/AppleIntelligenceTransitionPlan.md Docs/CANONICAL_OPENINTELLIGENCE_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md RELEASE_NOTES.md and the Notion roadmap DB 37f49a74-d54f-81b7-9424-dae1288c0043
why_it_matters: AGENTS.md rule 14 is mandatory; skipping it recreates the doc-drift the audit fixed (risk R20)
verification_command: diff check that doc files changed alongside any feature commit
failure_mode: Documentation drifts from code again; future agents inherit false claims
